subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps from discovery call - Aurora Retail
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@auroraretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up + stakeholder mapping request (Aurora Retail)

Hi Priya  thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from my side and a couple of asks so we can move to a technical deep dive next week:

Summary from todays call:
- Primary use case: reduce latency on personalization inference for cart & checkout flows; prioritize 99th percentile latency and cost per 1M tokens.
- Expected QPS: 400 peak, with seasonality spikes; target P95 < 200ms for API calls.
- Security needs: SOC 2, data residency in US, DPA with standard carve-outs.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you share a simple org chart or list of stakeholders (economic buyer, procurement contact, security/compliance lead, and the engineering lead for infra)? A short PDF or CSV is perfect.
2) Would Tom Benson (CTO) be the economic buyer/approver? If not, who should we loop in?
3) Can you confirm procurement timeline/steps (PO, vendor form, security questionnaire)?
4) Ive attached a brief stakeholder-request template that helps us map responsibilities  if easier, fill that out and send back.

Proposed immediate next step: schedule a 45-min technical deep dive with your engineering and infra team. Im available Weds/Thurs next week  here's my calendar: https://calendly.com/alex-martinez/30min

Attachments: redwood-stakeholder-request-template.docx

Thanks  Ill put together a short mutual action plan (milestones + owners) once we have the stakeholder list.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | https://www.redwoodinference.com

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@auroraretail.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up + stakeholder mapping request (Aurora Retail)

Hi Alex  thanks for the clear recap. Great to see the alignment on latency and cost goals. Im attaching a quick org chart and a CSV with the procurement contacts.

Quick answers:
- Tom is the technical sponsor and will be involved in the final approval, but the economic buyer is likely Rebecca Lin (VP Product). Ive copied Tom on this thread; Ill introduce Rebecca in a follow-up once I confirm availability.
- Procurement: typical process here  vendor questionnaire  security review (well need SOC 2 and controls evidence)  PO & standard MSAs. Timeline is usually 36 weeks for a straightforward procurement with no novel data controls.
- Security lead: Sandra Lopez (copied in the CSV) will own the questionnaire and evidence requests.

Ive attached: aurora-org-chart-v1.pdf and aurora-procurement-contacts.csv (contains Sandras contact).

Can you send over a copy of Redwood’s standard SOC 2 summary and a short doc outlining how you handle PII in inference calls? Sandra will need that to kick off the review.

Thanks  Ill try to get Rebecca looped in by end of week.

Best,
Priya Shah
Director of Data & Personalization | Aurora Retail

Attachments: aurora-org-chart-v1.pdf, aurora-procurement-contacts.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up + stakeholder mapping request (Aurora Retail)

Quick internal note  thanks for the thread, Alex. I mapped the stakeholders Priya sent and sketched a suggested intro cadence below. High-level observations:

Stakeholder map (from Priyas attachments):
- Technical sponsor: Tom Benson (CTO)  will attend technical deep dive
- Economic buyer: Rebecca Lin (VP Product)  likely final approver for spend
- Security/compliance: Sandra Lopez (Security Lead)  will own questionnaire and SOC 2 evidence requests
- Procurement admin: Aaron Kim (Procurement Specialist)  process & PO

Decision criteria we should surface in the next conversation:
- Latency guarantees at P95/P99 under peak QPS (we should prepare our P95/P99 benchmarks and test plan)
- Data handling & residency (explicit steps for PII masking and logs retention)
- Pricing model for burst capacity and any committed discounts (Dedicated vs Hosted)
- Support/SLAs for production rollouts and failover behavior

Suggested immediate actions (owners):
- Alex: Send SOC2 summary + short PII handling one-pager to Sandra (include our security questionnaire link).
- Rishi: Prep a 3045min tech deep dive deck focusing on latency tests, KV cache strategy, and deployment options.
- Marissa: Draft a mutual action plan template (milestones, owners, timeline) after tech deep dive; Ill lead procurement coordination.

Suggested intro language for Rebecca (economic buyer):
"Hi Rebecca  Priya and Tom suggested I introduce Alex Martinez from Redwood Inference. Redwood helps teams reduce inference latency and unit cost for personalization use cases; they’ve run comparable tests for other retail customers. Would you be open to a 15-min chat about high-level business outcomes and budget?"

I also attached a filled copy of the stakeholder-request-template to reduce back-and-forth.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
